# Fetch all pages of received payment requests and sum amounts for the last 5 days
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Define date range (today is 2023-06-03, last 5 days inclusive)
today = datetime(2023, 6, 3)
start_date = today - timedelta(days=4)  # 2023-05-30
end_date = today

# Fetch pages until we have all requests or see items older than start_date
all_requests = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    # Check if the first item is older than start_date (assuming sorted descending)
    first_date = datetime.fromisoformat(page[0]['created_at'])
    if first_date < start_date:
        # No more items in range, but we still need to include items from this page that are in range
        # Actually if first is older, all are older, so break
        break
    all_requests.extend(page)
    # If we got fewer than 20 items, no more pages
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Filter requests within the last 5 days
filtered = [r for r in all_requests if start_date <= datetime.fromisoformat(r['created_at']) <= end_date]

# Sum amounts
total = sum(r['amount'] for r in filtered)
print(f"Total requested in last 5 days: {total}")
